Triage: graded — `pm:queue` + `domain:ui` (finding label off), type Task. Lands in `packages/plugin-list/src/ObjectGallery.tsx` and `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectDataTable.tsx` (published-library prop types → ui lane).

Rationale: measurement-first repair with named landing points; anchoring the two orphan prop types to a real schema restores the house invariant the other widgets already hold (`PivotTableSchema & {…}` shape), it is not new capability. The card's own three measurements are the dispatch's first steps: (1) whether an anchor exists for `plugin-list` (a `GallerySchema` may not exist — if a **new exported schema type** must be created, that is new public surface: stop and report, don't invent it silently); (2) whether the inline members have drifted from what each component reads (#6170/#6357 class); (3) the strictness disagreement — whichever anchor is chosen, one widget's compile-time acceptance changes, so the PR must state which side moved and why, with the #5424 present-and-undefined discipline in mind.

Serial constraint: PR #6574 (#6357) is in flight and ratchets these two types' local `bind` members — dispatch only after it lands and re-verify both sites on the merged ref. Not folded with #6357: different defect, different remedy (the card argues this and the ratchet-vs-delete asymmetry proves it).
